name: Creature in the Corner
source:
THERE'S A CREATURE IN THE CORNER OF YOUR ROOM...

AND IT SEEMS HUNGRY.

YOUR CHOICES WILL DECIDE WHAT THE CREATURE CONSUMES (HOPEFULLY NOT YOU).

[From [url=https://headlocker.itch.io/creature-in-the-corner]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你房间的角落里有一个生物……

它看起来很饿。

你的选择将决定该生物消耗什么（希望不是你）。

[来自[url=https://headlocker.itch.io/creature-in-the-corner]Itch.io[/url]]
